category_title: Integrated student with ADHD who uses self-regulation and support staff to manage sensory/social overwhelm
scenario_title: Group work organization during film project
minimal_context: The students are organizing themselves into groups in the classroom to continue working on their film project.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: You may continue to work on your film now. Please organize yourselves into groups and delegate the tasks.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Sits by the windowsill and takes pleasure in reading a book while the other children cheer and begin to organize themselves.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Adam, shouldn't you participate in the group work?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Continues to sit by the windowsill reading the book.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: You need to join the others for the film project.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: There is too much to cope with right now as everyone is talking over each other.
